name: nostr-pqc
description: Index of post-quantum cryptography (PQC) work in the Nostr protocol.
note: Status values: shipped | published | experimental | discussion | closed. Protects values: confidentiality | authenticity. Approach values: hybrid | replacement | n-a.

projects.name: Nostr WoT Extension
implementation: Derives ML-KEM-1024 and ML-DSA-87 keys from the BIP-39 seed as siblings of the secp256k1 key, via domain-separated HKDF-SHA256
Publishes a kind:10203 attestation advertising the post-quantum public keys
ML-DSA proof of possession binding the npub to both public keys
Post-quantum direct messages over NIP-44 + NIP-59, hybrid with the NIP-44 conversation key
Additive NIP-07 surface: encrypt(pubkey, plaintext, { scheme: 'pq', recipientKemKey })
Offline CLI (npm run pqc:keygen) that derives keys and prints a signed attestation without a browser
New identities generated with 24 words so the seed is not the weakest link
projects.notes: First Nostr signer to ship post-quantum keys to end users. Requires no relay changes.

projects.name: @nostr-wot/pq
implementation: derivePqKeys: NIP-06 seed to ML-KEM-1024 + ML-DSA-87 keypairs
kind:10203 attestation build, parse and verify with typed problem codes
Self-describing versioned message envelope: 1-byte version, 1-byte alg, 1568-byte ML-KEM ciphertext, 24-byte nonce, AEAD-sealed padded plaintext
hybridKey: HKDF combination of the KEM secret with the NIP-44 conversation key
createPqDirectMessage / openPqDirectMessage: NIP-17 rumor sealed and gift-wrapped per NIP-59, envelope placed at the seal layer
Authenticated framing: version, algorithm and both pubkeys in the AEAD associated data
NIP-44 length padding and a single generic decryption error

overhead.measured_on: complete kind:1059 gift wrap as serialized for a relay

projects.notes: Reference implementation responding to nostr-protocol/nips#1971. Rides inside unchanged NIP-59 gift wrap, so relays need no changes.

projects.name: Dart NDK quantum-secure signer
implementation: QsRustEventSigner / QsRustEventVerifier over native Rust FFI using the crystals-dilithium crate
Selectable security level 2, 3 or 5 (~AES-128 / ~AES-192 / ~AES-256)
Replaces BIP-340 Schnorr event signatures rather than augmenting them
projects.notes: Published as a demo to provoke ecosystem discussion, not as a production identity scheme. Targets the authenticity half of the problem, complementary to the KEM work.

projects.name: NIP-44 post-quantum security
projects.author: paulmillr
implementation: Argues for hybrid ECDH + KEM constructions rather than outright replacement
Open questions: where post-quantum public keys are stored and discovered, and application beyond DMs
projects.notes: The canonical discussion thread for post-quantum Nostr encryption.

projects.name: NIP-101 Algorithm Transition for Signatures and Encryption
projects.author: eznix86
implementation: Generic framework for transitioning Nostr cryptographic algorithms without breaking compatibility
projects.notes: Closed. The discussion is the useful artifact: signatures judged non-urgent, encryption urgent due to harvest-now-decrypt-later.

projects.name: @noble/post-quantum
implementation: Auditable, dependency-light NIST post-quantum primitives used by the JavaScript Nostr implementations indexed here

adjacent.name: nostr-double-ratchet
adjacent.reason: Signal double ratchet over NIP-44 giving forward secrecy and post-compromise recovery, but entirely classical elliptic-curve cryptography. Frequently miscited as quantum protection; forward secrecy does not help against an adversary who breaks the underlying curve.
